jobs.description:
South Asian Cuisine Chef – Indian & Pakistani Specialities

 

Big Bowl Valby is seeking a skilled and experienced chef specialising in South Asian cuisine, particularly Indian and Pakistani dishes, for a permanent, full-time position.

 

Responsibilities

 

• 
Prepare authentic Indian, Pakistani and other South Asian dishes.

• 
Ensure consistent food quality, taste and presentation.

• 
Participate in menu development and recipe standardisation.

• 
Maintain food hygiene and comply with Danish food safety regulations.

• 
Manage ingredients efficiently and contribute to food-cost and waste control.

• 
Cooperate with the kitchen and restaurant team.

Qualifications

 

• 
Relevant professional experience as a chef specialising in South Asian cuisine.

• 
Strong knowledge of Indian and Pakistani cooking techniques, spices and ingredients.

• 
Ability to work independently in a professional kitchen.

• 
Reliable, flexible and able to work evenings and weekends.

• 
English communication skills are required. Danish is an advantage.

 

Employment Conditions

 

Employer: Big Bowl Entertainment ApS

Workplace: Valby, Denmark

Employment: Permanent, full-time position

Working Hours: 37 hours per week

Salary: DKK 38,000 gross per month

Starting Date: As soon as possible or by agreement.

 

Application

 

Please send your CV and application describing your relevant professional experience to af@bigbowl.dk

 Contact Person: Fawad Ahmad

Application Deadline: 15-08-2026

 

Big Bowl Valby welcomes applications from all qualified candidates. Recruitment will be based on qualifications, professional experience and suitability for the position.

jobs.occupation: Slaughter Operatives Tican Fresh Meat A/S, Thisted and Brørup  We’re Hiring Slaughter Operatives
jobs.description:
Tican Fresh Meat A/S is owned by the Tönnies Group, one of the world’s largest food companies. 95% of our production is exported, mainly to Germany and distant markets. The factory in both Thisted and Brørup employs around 1400 people in total. The major part is slaughter operatives.  Tican is a company with deep roots and traditions, and our history dates back to 1928.

We are in the lookout for new colleagues who want an exciting future in an international food group and are willing to help develop the company. Among other things, we are investing in increased automation so that our colleagues have the best possible platform for carrying out their daily tasks. Above all, we are a company of #butchers, #meatjobs, #diversity and #agoodplacetobe.

We are looking for different employee categories. Knife experience and butchery skills would be an advantage. It is an advantage if you speak Danish or English, German or Polish, but not a requirement. You preferably have experience in the food industry.

We are especially on the lookout for experienced knife workers, slaughter operatives for the butchery chain, and also slaughter operative for cutting/boning.

We offer:

·        An exciting and challenging workplace with excellent conditions

·        Good, solid training

·        Dynamic collaboration with talented colleagues

·        Opportunities for professional and personal development

ü  An attractive salary package starting as soon as possible        ?

ü  Good colleagues  

We expect you to:

·        Be at least 18 years old

·        Have an efficient work style and thrive in an active and cheerful department

·        Be serious and stable in terms of attendance

You will be part of the existing team with a 37-hour working week in Brorup, or a 42,5 hour week in Thisted according to a local agreement.  The workplace is Markedsvej 9, 6650 Brørup, Denmark or Strandvejen 7, 7700 Thisted ,Denmark

Contact:

Please send your application by e-mail to job@tican.dk, subject Knife workers, slaughter operative “ Brørup” or “ Thisted “

Applications are assessed on an ongoing basis and positions will be filled as soon as we have found the right candidates.      

Tican Fresh Meat A/S is locally known beyond all borders. Read more on the website www.tican.dk.

jobs.occupation: DEKRA-owned Force Aerospace Testing is looking for NDT Engineers
jobs.description:
Work with Aviation. Build Your Future with DEKRA.

At DEKRA, you will work in an environment where technology, safety, and real world operations come together. You will be part of a global organization supporting the aviation industry through specialized inspection and testing services that help ensure reliability and safety across airports and aircraft operations.

This role offers a unique combination of technical responsibility, mobility, and personal freedom. You will work hands on with aircraft and components across the Nordic region while continuously developing your expertise in a highly specialized field.

For someone who enjoys technology, variation, and practical problem solving, this is an opportunity to build a long term career in an industry where quality and precision truly matter.

What will you do?

As an NDT Technician at DEKRA, you will:

    

Perform Non Destructive Testing (NDT) on aircraft, helicopters, and components

    

Work with several different aircraft types and technical environments

    

Travel extensively to customer sites and airports across the Nordic region, with occasional international assignments

    

Work closely with customers, suppliers, and colleagues while contributing to safety, reliability, and quality within aviation maintenance

 The role offers a high degree of freedom, mobility, and responsibility, making it ideal for someone who enjoys variation, technical challenges, and working in dynamic environments.

Who are we looking for? We are looking for someone with a strong technical mindset who enjoys practical work, takes responsibility, and thrives in an environment where no two days look exactly the same.

We believe you have:

    

Certification within the following NDT methods:  EN9712- ET2, UT1 and PT2

    

Good communication skills in English

    

A valid driver’s license (B)

    

Good computer skills

    

Flexibility and willingness to travel and work away from home 

It is considered a strong advantage if you also have:

    

Previous experience within aviation, for example as an aircraft mechanic/technician or in a similar technical role

    

Certification according to EN4179

    

Knowledge of Swedish, Danish, or another Nordic language

Personal qualities will be an important part of the selection process. We are looking for someone who is reliable, curious, adaptable, and motivated by continuous learning and development. You enjoy taking responsibility, solving technical challenges, and adapting to different customer environments and situations. 

Get go know DEKRA

DEKRA is one of the world’s leading expert organizations within safety, inspection, testing, and certification. With operations in more than 60 countries, DEKRA works across several industries to help create safer systems, workplaces, and technologies.

Within aviation, DEKRA supports customers with specialized technical expertise and inspection services focused on safety, quality, and reliability.

This is a direct recruitment where you will be employed directly by DEKRA, while Qlose manages the recruitment process.

 Have we caught your interest?

Great, that’s usually a good sign 🌟

Click “Apply now” and attach your CV or LinkedIn profile, and we’ll take it from there. We work with continuous selection, so don’t wait too long, we appreciate curiosity and people who like to take initiative.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact Linnea at linnea.neldemo@qlose.io

Vacation season? Same here! 🌞 During the summer holiday period (weeks 28–31), our team will be operating with reduced staffing, so our response time may be a little longer than usual. Feel free to apply today – we look forward to reviewing your application as soon as we're back!

jobs.occupation: Sales Oriented Business Manager to ALTEN Denmark
jobs.description:
Would you like to work in a varied role with a focus on sales, recruitment and leadership? Then we have the position for you! ALTEN Group is seeking to appoint a Business Manager with the aim to develop our business to the Danish market. 
 
As Business Manager, you will be responsible for establishing and developing the ALTEN organization in Denmark where you will report directly to the Managing Director of Sweden. 

To be considered for the role as Business Manager, you are required to have a master degree within engineering or business as well as 3 to 5 years’ relevant experience of working within sales and/or recruitment. Furthermore, you are fluent in both Danish and English, spoken as well as written. Experience of the IT or Technology consultancy business is meritorious. 

As a person, you are committed with a strong interest in sales and business development. You appreciate challenges and have a goal-oriented mindset. You prefer working in a fast-paced and inconstant environment. In addition to this, you are good at establishing and maintaining relationships with other people.

The position is located in Copenhagen but frequent travel will occur, both nationally and internationally. Your main responsibilities as Business Manager are: 
- Prospection and sales towards new and existent clients
- Managing the entire recruitment process, from need to hiring
- Managing the group of consultants you have hired 
- Coaching, support and career development of your consultants 
- Producing accurate business forecasts and reports for your Business Unit
- Budget responsibility for your Business Unit About ALTEN Group
With over 30 000 employees in 22 countries, we develop and deliver competence for world leading companies through the most committed engineering and IT consultants. Our customers are found in industries such as Energy, Telecom, Automotive, Defence & Aerospace and Life Science and we are active throughout the whole product lifecycle. We offer you an interesting role in an international environment with a clearly defined career ladder for your own development. As Business Manager, you also have both international and national educations as well as regular coaching.
